name: peaku-prueba
description: Prueba técnica Full Stack — microservicios NestJS + Angular

scripts.build: pnpm --filter "./libs/**" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/**" run build
scripts.dev:prebuild: pnpm --filter @peaku/shared run build && pnpm --filter @peaku/auth-service run build && pnpm --filter @peaku/products-service run build && pnpm --filter @peaku/api-gateway run build
scripts.dev: pnpm dev:cleanports && pnpm dev:prebuild && concurrently -k -i --restart-tries 0 -n MONGO,AUTH,PROD,GW,FRONT -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "pnpm dev:db" "pnpm dev:auth" "pnpm dev:products" "pnpm dev:gateway" "pnpm dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: pnpm dev:cleanports && pnpm dev:prebuild && concurrently -k -i --restart-tries 0 -n MONGO,AUTH,PROD,GW -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "pnpm dev:db" "pnpm dev:auth" "pnpm dev:products" "pnpm dev:gateway"
scripts.dev:gateway: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3001 tcp:127.0.0.1:3002 -t 60000 && node --env-file=.env scripts/dev-service.cjs gateway
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build && pnpm seed
